fields.value: Replication archive Peeters & Szymanski (2014) Economic Policy

dsDescriptionValue.value: This record contains the replication archive for the paper "Financial Fair Play in European Football" by Thomas Peeters and Stefan Szymanski, which appeared in Economic Policy in 2014. Please read the Readme file first, which gives an overview of the files made available and the programs to replicate the results.

fields.value:
This entry is a seventy-four-file data package totaling 36.4 MB, containing files in .pdf, .do, .dta, .out and .m formats.

If you use this dataset, please cite: Peeters, Thomas; Szymanski, Stefan (2021). Replication archive Peeters & Szymanski (2014) Economic Policy. Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR). Dataset. https://doi.org/10.25397/eur.13622150
